cd /workspace && python - <<'EOF'
import io
from dotenv.parser import parse_stream
cases = {
    "X=value   \n": ("X", "value"),
    "Y=word # comment\n": ("Y", "word"),
    "Z=value\t# c\n": ("Z", "value"),
    "A=  value  \n": ("A", "value"),
    "E=hello world  \n": ("E", "hello world"),
    "C=value#nospace\n": ("C", "value#nospace"),
    "B=first\nD=second   \n": ("D", "second"),
}
ok = True
for src, (k, v) in cases.items():
    rows = [r for r in parse_stream(io.StringIO(src)) if r.key]
    got = rows[-1].value
    status = "PASS" if got == v else "FAIL"
    if got != v: ok = False
    print(f"{status}: {src.strip()!r} -> {got!r} (want {v!r})")
print("ALL_OK" if ok else "MISMATCH")
EOF
